questions: What does production scheduling actually cost?
Is the async RequestQueue path benched?

findings.detail: PriorityQueue = BinaryHeap O(log n), cheap Ord; existing benches measure the bare structure -> no algorithmic win.
RequestQueue::enqueue/dequeue wrap the heap in async tokio::Mutex + Notify -> per-request concurrency tax, UNMEASURED.
async bench feasible via tokio Runtime + block_on; RequestQueue public; no new criterion feature.
async round-trip vs bare-heap isolates the Mutex+Notify tax -> decides any follow-up.
